book: Agrawal ExamCart, SSB OIR, Reasoning section
scans: SSR OIR 1-127 (phone photos of printed pages 1-127)
title: Mirror and Water Images
note: Only questions printed as text (letters, digits, arrows and triangles) are transcribed in full; drawn figures carry a one-line description and are held. A text question's options are stored twice: `answerPanels` holds each option glyph by glyph as printed, left to right, each glyph plain, flipped left to right (x), upside down (y) or turned half round (xy); `options` says the same in words for screen readers. Each glyph is written as the character of the question it stands for, with the flip that draws its printed shape. Where two flips draw the same shape for that character, the simpler is written: plain for a symmetric letter (A, O, T...), across rather than upside down for 3, B, C, D, E, K, and plain for N or S turned half round. Readings at the limit of the photos: Q12 A prints an undotted l where C prints i (the only difference between them). Q22 D's 1 shows no flag on its left, read as flipped. Q59: A, B and D print a serifed I where C prints a 1 upside down; A and B read the same glyph for glyph and differ in spacing only. Q37: the small a's left-right turn cannot be seen in the photo; it is read as flipped across in options A and D. Q27 A, B and D read the same glyph for glyph. Q24 B lies on the curve of the page. Q38: the B is read reversed in B and D and plain in A and C, at 22 times zoom. Q54 and Q58 B end in a round O that may be a zero; both look the same upside down. Q13 draws MN as a vertical mirror on the right, but its options are water images. Q58 B prints Q54's series in place of an image of SHARE. Q53 prints SEARCH in a frame shaped like an arrow, which is not transcribed. Q31 is a grid of letters and is held as a figure. Q55-57 print options (A) (a), (B) (b), (C) (d), (D) (d) under four figures a-d; they are held as figures. Q31 and Q50-60 each print their own question, kept as its direction. Q75 and Q76 follow the direction for Q61-74 in form, but no printed direction covers them.

directions.text: If a mirror is placed on the line AB and MN then out of the option figures which figure will be the right image of the question figure?
Which of the answer figures is the exact mirror image of the given problem figure when the mirror is held at the right side ?

In each question there is a question figure on the above and four answer figures marked (A), (B), (C) and (D) are given below. Select the answer figure which is exactly the mirror image of the question figure when the mirror is held at XY.
Select the correct water image of the given figure.
Select the correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is placed at AB as shown.
Choose the correct mirror image of the figure (X) :
Which of the following is the water image of 5374 ?
What would be the water image of SEARCH ?
Choose the alternative that resembles the water image of the given alpha-numeric series below:
If you see the problem figure in the mirror along the dotted line, which figure out of the four figures a, b, c and d will be the mirror image of figure 'X' ?
